question: Does complaint-aware routing preserve more generator-intended complaints than negative-sentiment-only gating, and how do lexical preprocessing and representation affect category grouping?
data: Supplied synthetic CSV, generator intent reconstructed by exact base-template matching; not independent ground truth
baseline: Original commit 69c5c94, VADER binary gate and 500-feature TF-IDF/KMeans
comparisons: VADER negative gate with neutral preserved
selection: Default k=7 remains a demo parameter, not an empirically optimal category count. Report every comparison; no held-out generalization claim from the supplied templates.
independent_study: Separate blinded annotator labels required before reporting independent accuracy or advice utility. Provide protocol and blank annotation files; do not fill human ratings automatically.
claims_disallowed: live NVIDIA success from configuration alone
